title: SpeechCanvas prompt pack
description: Final validated output of the Muse/Guardian/Critic/Composer swarm. Structural validation also available offline via scripts/validate_pack.py (stdlib, same contract).

motif.description: Symbolic motif carrying the message (see references/rules.md allowed motifs).

lighting.description: Lighting design, e.g. cold blue moonlight with dust.

lens.description: Camera, focal length, aperture, film/ISO feel.

gesture.description: Posture, action, or deliberate absence of a person.

constraints.description: Safety and factual fences. MUST include the six standard fences listed in references/rules.md.

iteration.description: Refinement round that produced this pack (cap 3).

guardian_status.description: Guardian verdict; deliverable packs must be PASS.

critic_notes.description: Most valuable realism fix from the Critic.

deception_theme.description: True if the pack themes deception/propaganda; then an allowed motif is MANDATORY.
